questions.question: As your motorcycle goes faster, you will:
questions.correctAnswerText: Shift up to higher gears.
questions.explanation: You must shift into higher gears as your motorcycle speeds up.

questions.question: When riding a motorcycle, you should:

options.text: Wear a jacket only at night.
Wear a jacket only when it is cold.

questions.correctAnswerText: Always wear a jacket.
questions.explanation: Always wear a sturdy jacket with long sleeves when riding, no matter how warm it is outside.

questions.question: How do you know if your motorcycle fits you?

options.text: Your feet touch the ground when you sit on the motorcycle.
The seat is no more than 10 inches above your waist when you stand next to it.
The handlebars are above your head when you sit down.

questions.correctAnswerText: Your feet touch the ground when you sit on the motorcycle.
questions.explanation: Your feet must touch the ground when sitting on your motorcycle. Riding a motorcycle that does not fit is unsafe.

questions.question: If a rider wears a helmet during a crash, they are:

options.text: Less likely to survive than someone without a helmet.
Just as likely to survive as someone without a helmet.
More likely to survive than someone without a helmet.

questions.correctAnswerText: More likely to survive than someone without a helmet.
questions.explanation: Riders without helmets are three times more likely to die from head injuries than riders wearing helmets, regardless of speed.

questions.question: The best way to handle a tailgater is to:

options.text: Slow down or change lanes to let them pass.
Speed up to get more distance between you.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down or change lanes to let them pass.
questions.explanation: If safe, change lanes and let them pass. Speeding up may cause them to tailgate you at a higher speed, which is more dangerous.

questions.question: When the lights on a railroad crossing sign are flashing, what should you do?

options.text: Stop and wait until the train passes.
Turn around and find another route.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop and wait until the train passes.
questions.explanation: Stop completely at a railroad crossing with flashing lights. Wait until the train passes and the lights stop before going forward. Never try to beat a train.

questions.question: Unlike other beverages, alcohol:
questions.correctAnswerText: Goes into the bloodstream immediately.
questions.explanation: Alcohol does not need digestion. It passes directly through the stomach and small intestine walls, enters the blood, and quickly reaches the brain.

questions.question: The best way to help others see your motorcycle is to:
questions.correctAnswerText: Use your headlight.
questions.explanation: Keep your headlight on at all times. Motorcycles made after 1978 turn on the headlight automatically when running. Check that your headlight works before every ride.

questions.question: When riding in a group, riders should:

options.text: Keep safe distances from each other.
Follow each other as closely as possible.
Not worry about distances between riders.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep safe distances from each other.
questions.explanation: Ride in a staggered formation when in a group. This lets you stay close together while keeping safe distances.

questions.question: Your chances of surviving a crash improve if you wear:
questions.correctAnswerText: A DOT-approved helmet.
questions.explanation: Wear a helmet that meets U.S. Department of Transportation (DOT) and state standards for the best head and neck protection. A good helmet is the most important thing you can wear to survive a crash.

questions.question: What does a solid white line on the side of the road mean?

options.text: The right edge of a traffic lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: The right edge of a traffic lane.
questions.explanation: A solid white line on the side of the road shows where the right edge of a traffic lane is.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Merge
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black symbols or words. This sign warns drivers that traffic ahead is merging.

questions.question: Why should you use your mirrors when stopping at an intersection?

options.text: To check if drivers behind you know you are stopping.
To look for dark clouds showing bad weather.

questions.correctAnswerText: To check if drivers behind you know you are stopping.
questions.explanation: Check your mirrors often to see if drivers behind you are paying attention to you. Use your mirrors when stopping to make sure drivers behind you are reacting to your actions.

questions.question: What can a motorcycle rider do to reduce the chance of a collision?

options.text: Keep enough space between yourself and other vehicles.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep enough space between yourself and other vehicles.
questions.explanation: Always keep a safe space cushion around your motorcycle. Maintain this space when following other vehicles, being followed, passing, or being passed.

questions.question: How should you load saddlebags on a motorcycle?

options.text: Put about the same weight in each bag.
Put more weight in one bag than the other.
Put as much weight as possible in one bag.

questions.correctAnswerText: Put about the same weight in each bag.
questions.explanation: Load saddlebags with equal weight in each one. If weight is uneven, the motorcycle may drift to one side.

questions.question: What is a benefit of keeping space between you and other vehicles?

options.text: You can draft off other vehicles more easily.
You will have more time to react to what other drivers do.

questions.correctAnswerText: You will have more time to react to what other drivers do.
questions.explanation: Keep a safe space around your motorcycle at all times. This gives you more time to respond to dangers and more room to move safely.

questions.question: What footwear is best for motorcycle riders?
questions.correctAnswerText: Sturdy boots.
questions.explanation: Leather boots give the best foot protection. Boots should be high and sturdy enough to cover and support your ankles.

questions.question: What material gives the best protection if you crash?
questions.correctAnswerText: Leather or synthetic materials
questions.explanation: Clothing made from sturdy leather or synthetic materials offers the best crash protection. Always wear long pants and a jacket when riding.

questions.question: What happens when alcohol and drugs are used together?

options.text: They are less dangerous than using either alone.
Their effects can be stronger than using either alone.

questions.correctAnswerText: Their effects can be stronger than using either alone.
questions.explanation: Many drugs, including prescription and over-the-counter medicines, can make riding unsafe. Some drugs become even more dangerous when mixed with alcohol.

questions.question: What removes alcohol from your body?
questions.correctAnswerText: Time
questions.explanation: Only time will remove alcohol from your body. No tricks or techniques will speed up this process.
